lines.t: I was walking through a valley low Where the cold would never seem to go
Then a whisper came into the dark Like a flame that found my heart
Every step was full of grace, every tear you left in place
And when I called out in the night, you became my morning light
Now my soul is waking up, drawn into your endless love
Every shadow has to flee, when your glory covers me
You are the light of the kingdom
You are the song of the redeemed
You are the hope that holds forever
You are the fire inside of me
Yahushua, King of Heaven
Let your praise rise endlessly
You are the light of the kingdom
And your life is living on me
I was chasing after empty things Just a restless heart with broken wings
But you lifted me above the dust Taught my soul how to trust
Now I stand with hands raised high No more fear, no need to hide
Every breath belongs to you Every promise proves you're true
Now my soul is waking up
Drawn into your endless love
Every shadow has to flee
When your glory covers me
You are the light of the kingdom
You are the song of the redeemed
You are the hope that holds forever
You are the fire inside of me
Yahushua, King of heaven Let your praise rise endlessly
You are the light of the kingdom And your life is living in me
Forever holy, forever near You are peace that casts out fear
Forever worthy, forever strong You are where my heart belongs
King above and Lamb of love
Reigning now and reigning on
All my life will testify
You alone are glorified
You are the light of the kingdom
You are the song of the redeemed
You are the hope that holds forever
You are the fire inside of me
Yahushua, King of heaven, let your praise rise endlessly
You are the light of the kingdom and your life is living in me
Living in me, living in me
Light of the kingdom
Living in me
